title: Look to the Rock
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders, and tonight is about looking back gently: Isaiah tells a discouraged people to look at the rock they were cut from, and Wren sits on the rug with her great-grandma's photograph and asks questions until she learns that families are a rock we can stand on.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because looking back gently teaches us who we are. In Wren’s world today: Wren found an old photograph of her great-grandma inside a box in the closet. She sat down on the rug and asked questions until dinner was ready. Then she carried the picture to the table to show everyone. Just like the people who looked back to Abraham and Sarah, Wren learned that families are a rock we can stand on.
